entities.name: EcfA1 query protein
observations: The 281-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q88XV2, an EcfA1 ATP-binding component of an energy-coupling factor ABC transporter.
Predicted molecular weight is 30,855.883 Da; theoretical pI 5.325; estimated charge at pH 7 is -7.012; instability index 34.335; GRAVY -0.2053.
Sequence contains the Walker A-like P-loop motif GHNGSGKST and Pfam domains ABC_tran (positions 25–171), AAA_22 (38–198), and EcfA1_C (244–281).
Curated homolog annotations support ATP binding and hydrolysis as the energy-providing activity in an ECF transporter complex; no explicit catalytic reaction equation was retrieved.
The protein is a peripheral membrane component that forms an ECF complex with membrane-embedded S and T components and a second ATP-binding protein.

entities.name: UniProt Q88XV2
observations: Reviewed Lactiplantibacillus plantarum EcfA1 ATP-binding protein; exact sequence match to the query.

entities.name: ECF ABC transporter
observations: Energy-coupling factor ABC transporter complex using paired ATP-binding proteins to energize transport through membrane-associated S and T components.
